pipelines.name: CERF Supplement Daily
pipelines.description: Daily OneGMS mirrors (CERF + CBPF allocations and projects → aa.cerf_*, aa.cbpf_*), then the storm and drought matchers (deterministic + Claude research, human replies on GitHub issues authoritative → aa.cerf_allocation_storm, aa.cerf_supplement), then the site export to the dev blob + Pages deploy dispatch.

pipelines.name: SEAS5 Skill Monthly Refresh
pipelines.description: Recomputes SEAS5-vs-ERA5 skill at admin 0/1/2 and per pixel for the new issuance, builds every payload of the static Pages site, verifies that all of them show that issuance, and publishes them as a bundle to the dev blob (projects/ds-seas5-skill/site/<YYYY-MM>/) for the GitHub Pages deploy workflow to pick up.
pipelines.schedule: At 13:15, on day 6 of the month UTC

pipelines.name: [dev adm_tdowning] SEAS5 Skill Monthly Refresh
pipelines.description: Recomputes SEAS5-vs-ERA5 skill at admin 0/1/2 and per pixel for the new issuance, builds every payload of the static Pages site, verifies that all of them show that issuance, and publishes them as a bundle to the dev blob (projects/ds-seas5-skill/site/<YYYY-MM>/) for the GitHub Pages deploy workflow to pick up.
pipelines.schedule: At 13:15, on day 6 of the month UTC

pipelines.name: NGA Riverine Flood Monitoring
pipelines.description: Daily Adamawa riverine flood AA monitor: GloFAS at Wuroboki (EWDS) + Google GRRR gauges → projects.ds_aa_nga_flooding_monitoring → chart → email → status page export. Replaces the GitHub Actions "Monitor flooding" cron.

pipelines.name: NGA Flash Flood Monitoring
pipelines.description: Daily BAY-states flash-flood AA monitor: per-LGA FloodScan × WorldPop exposure (app.floodscan_exposure, prod) vs thresholds → chart → email → status page export. Replaces the GitHub Actions "Monitor flash flooding" cron. Runs after the Flood Exposure Monitoring job.

pipelines.name: Flood Exposure Monitoring
pipelines.description: Daily FloodScan × WorldPop population-exposure chain: exposure rasters (blob) → admin raster stats (app.floodscan_exposure) → rolling quantiles (app.quantile / app.current_quantile). Consumed by the flood exposure app and the Nigeria flash-flood AA monitor.

pipelines.name: TCD Flood Monitoring
pipelines.description: Daily Chad riverine flood AA monitor: GloFAS forecast at N'Djamena (EWDS) → projects.pa_aa_tcd_flooding_monitoring → chart → email. Replaces the GitHub Actions "Monitor flooding" cron.

pipelines.name: AA Tracking Nightly (KB sync + aa snapshot)
pipelines.description: Upserts new knowledge-base framework pages into aa.framework_version, then snapshots the whole dev `aa` schema (parquet + DDL) to the dev blob under projects/ds-aa-tracking/snapshot/ for the GitHub Actions site build.
